sentences.en: Acting on your advice, I've decided to exercise more regularly.
sentences.zh: 根据你的建议，我决定要更经常地锻炼。

sentences.en: One regularly bumps into more beautiful women in the street.
sentences.zh: 走在街上经常会遇到更多漂亮的女人。

sentences.en: You'll have to visit me regularly for a while.
sentences.zh: 你得经常来看我一段时间。

senses.zh: 定期地；有规律地；整齐地
